subject: planner: fix return type was modified unexpectedly when building cast (#63387)
summary: Diff is a single-line change in `pkg/expression/constant_propagation.go`: pass `colType.DeepCopy()` into `BuildCastFunction` when casting a constant to a column type during constant propagation. This prevents `BuildCastFunctionWithCheck` (which mutates the provided `*types.FieldType`, e.g. flags/flen) from accidentally mutating `Column.RetType` via `col.GetType()`, avoiding planner/type corruption. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in expression semantics or runtime behavior; upstream/master retains the same fix.
